of.needed: whether the installation explicitly enables policy exceptions and sets the allowed namespace; the controlling configuration key is not named in the evidence

original.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes its defaults so policy exceptions are disabled and may only be created in a specified namespace (previously allowed in all namespaces, CVE-2024-48921); environments relying on PolicyExceptions must follow the upgrade guidance to keep them working.

decision.reason: [ev-2bd1a74f9c4a] says 1.13.0 changes the defaults so policy exceptions are disabled and can only be created in a specified namespace. That can only affect environments that actually use PolicyException resources, so the gvk-in-use operand is the right scope. The excerpt does not name the Helm value, flag or config key that turns exceptions back on or sets the namespace. So whether an installation is protected by explicit configuration can't be checked statically, and the undecidable(evidence-gap) operand describes that gap correctly instead of guessing a key.
